title: Trader Diary: When BTC hits $82.6k
content:
👀 8 AM: “Just a quick 2x long, I’ve got this.”
💥 8:15 AM: Margin call pops up, heart rate hits 200 BPM.
📉 8:30 AM: “It’s just a dip, HODL!” while refreshing the chart every 2 seconds.
😂 9:00 AM: Realize I’m now the meme on the #LeverageFails channel.
lesson: Never let FOMO dictate position size—set your max loss before you open a trade.
question: Who else turned a 2x dream into a 1‑minute panic session today? Drop your war stories 👇
